sources.title: IssueExec v1
sources.finding: Uses test retrieval, observed caller-callee hierarchy, bounded trace pruning, structural expansion and complete-source reranking. Study collects successful-test traces; it is not merely method coverage. Commit-history enrichment is an additional component.
sources.fit_inference: Current command-phase coverage is not a dynamic-call hierarchy. A separate prospective tracing feasibility experiment could supply a distinct acquisition channel, preserving uncovered source eligibility.
sources.constraints: Do not infer call edges from JaCoCo coverage or syntactic references. Keep failing/build-phase observations distinct from successful-test traces; preserve all unavailable cases, all production candidates and cost. Historical metadata must stop at frozen buggy revision; no fix commits.
sources.not_claimed: No transferred published gains, direct Java/GLM reproduction, causal proof or implemented hierarchy.

sources.title: Agent Retrieval Bench v1
sources.finding: Structural and semantic retrieval have complementary behavior; post-hoc rank fusion is evaluated separately. File reachability and useful span/context acquisition are distinct, and sampling/seed pilot limits remain.
sources.fit_inference: A separately fixed hybrid candidate-acquisition rule merits consideration after failure attribution, with unchanged context/candidate eligibility and all overhead counted.
sources.constraints: Do not tune fusion on exposed labels and call it confirmation. No replacement of official all-file evaluation with a favorable filter.

sources.title: FaR-Loc
sources.finding: Combines functionality descriptions, dense code retrieval and LLM reranking over covered methods.
sources.fit_inference: Dense semantic acquisition is distinct from prior r61 query rewriting, but requires provenance/capacity/cost qualification before implementation.
sources.constraints: No embedding install/model download or additional providers in this review; no borrowed Defects4J gains.

previously_tested.static_test_import_bridge: Already tested on exposed BugSwarm; candidate reach improved but MRR fell. Do not repeat as a new technique.
previously_tested.functionality_query_r61: Promising exposed results; requires source-admissible repository-disjoint confirmation, not same-case replay.

current_observation.interpretation: Partial behavior only. Does not prove premature stopping, quality failure or causal effect of wording.

next_decision: Finish original r10; verify full seal, run frozen label-free audit and scorer. Then attribute full-development outcomes to validity, candidate access, acquisition, ranking and overhead before freezing any successor. Protected confirmation remains separate; no easier population or relaxed gates.
claim_ceiling: Research candidate and local interface contrast, not implemented or measured benefit
open_questions: Can true test-scoped caller-callee traces be collected reliably for every retained Java case within a declared cost envelope?
If r10 fails, is the dominant failure candidate acquisition, selection/ranking, or overhead?
Which fixed complementary acquisition rule generalizes on protected confirmation without narrowing the candidate universe?
